capabilities: record a view count for each opened Markdown note
display note statistics in a dashboard with summary cards
mark notes with view-count badges and a never-viewed badge
search, sort and paginate notes in the dashboard
export statistics as JSON and reset recorded data
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see which notes you reopen often and which files have never been viewed.
summary: View-statistics tracker that counts note opens, shows a dashboard with sorting, search, pagination, badges and JSON export.
